# Radzen - Blazor Development Platform

> Radzen Ltd. builds tools for Blazor developers: Radzen Blazor Components (145+ open-source UI controls, MIT licensed), Radzen Blazor Studio (visual IDE), and an MCP server for AI-assisted Blazor development. Supports Material 3, Material 2, Fluent, and Bootstrap design systems. Used by Microsoft, NASA, Porsche, Dell, Siemens, DHL, and thousands of development teams.

**Products:** Radzen Blazor Components - free, open-source, 145+ native Blazor UI controls. Radzen Blazor Studio - visual designer with WYSIWYG canvas, database scaffolding, code generation, and GitHub Copilot integration. Radzen Blazor MCP Server - Model Context Protocol server for AI-assisted Blazor development, works with VS Code, Visual Studio, Cursor, and other MCP-capable IDEs. **Pricing:** Community edition is free. Blazor Pro is $799/year per developer. Blazor Team is $1,999/year for 3 developers.
